uzo.purpose: Shows where the current page sits in a hierarchy and links back up to each level; the first item may show an icon (slot icon-start).

instead.kialo: The places beside the page are a navigation, because a breadcrumb shows the ancestors above it, not the siblings; that is the navigado.
The steps of a process are no path up a hierarchy, because their order is the process and the person may not jump back freely; Fundamento has no step indicator yet, a person decides.

boundary.kialo: A level that opens a list of its sibling pages is not supported, because the item would move up and choose sideways at once; the trail leads up only, the pages beside one level belong to the navigado.

containers.name: page-header
containers.kialo: A breadcrumb stands at the head of the page above its heading, because the person reads where they are before what is there.

with.kialo: Its items are links, because each one moves up to a level; the last one, the current page, is text.
The separator between two items is the ikono chevron-right, decorative, because it points down the path and mirrors in right-to-left writing.
The middle of a long trail collapses into a menu (max-items), because the levels cut away must stay reachable; its entries are links, each moves up to its level.

case.de: Gezeigt werden die Seiten neben der aktuellen, nicht die darüber.
case.en: The pages beside the current one are shown, not those above it.

case.de: Es gibt nur einen Weg zurück, etwa zur Übersicht.
case.en: There is only one way back, such as to the overview.

do.de: Lass jede Ebene ihr Ziel benennen und die letzte die aktuelle Seite sein.
do.en: Let every level name its destination and the last one be the current page.

do.de: Begrenze lange Pfade mit max-items; die mittleren Ebenen stehen dann in einem Menü.
do.en: Limit long paths with max-items; the middle levels then stand in a menu.

do.de: Nimm emphasis low für einen Pfad, der neben einer Überschrift nur begleitet.
do.en: Use emphasis low for a path that only accompanies a heading.

dont.de: An einer Ebene eine Liste ihrer Nachbarseiten öffnen; der Pfad führt nur nach oben.
dont.en: Open a list of sibling pages at a level; the path only leads up.

dont.de: Die Schritte eines Ablaufs als Pfad zeigen, denn ihre Reihenfolge ist keine Rangordnung.
dont.en: Show the steps of a process as a path, because their order is no hierarchy.

none.de: Der Pfad nimmt keine eigene Taste; seine Ebenen sind Verweise, die man mit Tab erreicht und mit Enter öffnet, ausgelassene Ebenen öffnet ihr Menü.
none.en: The path takes no key of its own; its levels are links reached with Tab and opened with Enter, and hidden levels open from their menu.
